instruction: High-angle sports photograph, full shot. On a bright yellow judo mat, the wavy-haired man (R1) on the left executes a dynamic throw on the short-haired man (R2) who stands on the right. Both athletes wear white judo gis with black belts. R1 is bent deeply forward, gripping R2's gi to pull him off-balance, while R2 attempts to maintain his footing. Even overhead lighting illuminates the entire yellow training area, casting soft shadows on the floor and capturing the intense athletic movement of the practice session.
